post.description: Deterministic permission/cost preview of an AI-proposed action. It never starts anything.
Reports readiness without sending any case content.
Static review only: nothing is stored or run.

get.description: Server-sent events: node records as they appear, then the final state.

post.description: Runs the DRAFT against the template's fixture: no network, no writes. Every output is labelled simulated.
Apply diagnostic repair proposals to the DRAFT (never to a published version). Returns the diff and validation; publishing stays yours.
File-triggered workflows: the file is parsed offline and stored like an import, then the workflow runs on it.

get.description: The session indicator: anything still recording, visible from anywhere in the UI.

post.description: `import_capture` via the replay driver: bring an existing recording in through the device pipeline (raw body).
Exports confirmed observations as a PHANTOM handoff file. It launches nothing; the case owner approves the export.
Offline: no DNS and no packets. Shows exactly what each step would do and whether policy allows it.
Creates a task. It never sends a message or submits a takedown: a person does that outside this application.
Sanitized import (CSV, JSON, or a MISP event export). The file is read, redacted and discarded.
Exactly what would leave this machine, to whom, under what terms. Sends nothing. Refusals are explained here.
Logical merge for views/analysis only. Underlying entities, claims and evidence are never altered.

get.description: Points for the map. Each carries its accuracy statement; 'unknown' is shown, never invented.

post.description: Accepting never merges entities: it records a manual, evidence-backed `same_as` assertion that is reversible.

get.description:
Claims touched by human sources, with how many independent source groups back each. Single-source claims are
flagged. Nothing is scored.

post.description: Import-only: parse first, store second. A malformed file is rejected (422) and nothing is written.
Reversible: rejection only flips status; the row and its evidence stay.
What an export would contain and withhold, shown BEFORE anything is written (spec 13).

Name-similarity SUGGESTIONS only: each hit becomes a pending graph proposal for the analyst. Nothing is merged
and no entity is labelled sanctioned.

get.description: Full-text search (SQLite FTS5) across findings, notes, evidence titles and observations of ONE case.

post.description: Offline: recompute the spectrum of a stored SigMF archive with bounded FFT parameters. Stores nothing.

get.description: For a people case this lazily upgrades an existing case (idempotent, read-only on old tables) and returns its subject(s).
Three distinct times per item; `time_unknown` is explicit rather than silently substituted.

post.description: Promote an adapter finding to an analyst-owned claim. The adapter becomes the source group.

get.description: claim -> sources -> evidence -> acquisition record, so every statement can be traced to a hashed artifact.

post.description: Only an analyst can mark a claim verified; models and adapters cannot. Reversible (set back to unverified).

get.description: The conversation for this investigation (or the general one) with its messages and proposals. Damaged rows are skipped and counted.

post.description: Prioritised recommendations computed from the case's stored data. Deterministic: works with no model.

get.description: Non-blocking: every driver reports independently; missing libraries/drivers never affect anything else.

post.description:
Withdraws consent immediately. With delete_content the source's reports, derived claims and index entries are
removed (vault object kept only if another evidence row still references the same hash).

Create (or reuse) the case and subject, record the inputs and the authorization, and return the manifest: what will run, what cannot and why, and who would receive what.
With start=true the investigation begins at once; the named providers in approved_sources are the single approval for sources that send an input to a third party.
Smart paste: split on commas, semicolons and new lines and guess each value's type. The person can correct every guess; nothing is stored here.

get.description: Everything waiting for a person's decision across the investigations they can see.

post.description: Run the next step now and wait for what it starts. Normally the background driver does this; it is here for tests and for a stalled driver.
One bounded approval naming providers. The investigation continues on its own afterwards.

get.description: Durable replay: ask for events after the last sequence number you saw. A dropped connection loses nothing.

post.description: Re-run the permitted checks now (same limits, same approvals). 'Resume' only looks for NEW work.

get.description: Subjects past their retention period in cases you own. Nothing is deleted automatically.
The capability matrix for subject research: what each method needs, produces, costs and how well it has been exercised.
The audit-friendly activity ledger: one row per request that was reserved, with its provider, action, timing and result. It never holds a key or a target.
Work that is waiting, running or blocked, with the reason and the earliest time it may run (an estimate).

post.description: Forget 'rejected', 'plan restricted' and back-off marks after you changed the key or the plan. Sends nothing.
Spec 23.8 alias of POST /cases/{id}/reports.
Created DISABLED. Monitoring individuals needs an explicit acknowledgement and a documented case purpose.
Folds addresses that stored evidence already shows into candidates (no network) and previews the expansion plan that could find more.
Adds a CONFIRMED address as one of the subject's inputs. It is then covered by research and exposure checks only if the authorization covers it.
k-anonymity relay: accepts exactly five hex characters (never a password or a full hash), stores nothing.
Exactly what would leave this machine, to whom, at what cost. Sends nothing.
Records a result a person found by hand. The application did not run the search and makes no claim that a provider was queried.

get.description: A pixel-only re-encoded PNG. The original bytes are never served to the browser.
Sections, the research gaps panel and the next actions in one document.
Per source: returned -> findings -> unique candidate accounts -> profile entries, counted from the stored records.
Redacted export: restricted values are omitted, evidence is referenced by id and hash.

post.description: Several values at once, as rows or as a CSV / JSON file (columns: type, value, origin, source, evidence_ids, note). Bad rows are reported; good rows are kept.
Change an item's type (and with it its category). With preview=true nothing changes and the effects are listed. The value, evidence and verification state are untouched.
Bulk decisions with an impact preview. 'Mine' records the owner's own attestation; it is never independent corroboration.

get.description:
What verification exists for this target profile. Assets belong to a profile only through an explicit link made by a person (owner_subject_id on the
authorization, target_profile_id on the plan); a name that merely looks similar links nothing.

post.description: Installs a Target-profile template as a DISABLED draft bound to this subject: every run then needs the subject's live authorization.
Overwrite-and-delete the plaintext copies left by the one-time encryption migration (and pre-migration .bak files).

get.description: Result of the start-up self-check: did the app's own processes open outside connections while idle?
Lists sources past their retention date. Nothing is deleted automatically.

post.description: Graceful stop requested by the desktop shell (lifespan then cancels jobs and checkpoints the WAL).
Validation + every request the whole DAG would make. Contacts nothing.
